creation_gate.shortest_normal_path: one Opus relationship reviewer binds each evidence request to an unobserved review predicate, jointly issues only known independent requests, and returns one structured review
creation_gate.observed_error_path: Candidate170 reduced the transferred control to seven fixed reads; its two measured C02 runs used additional accesses and produced quality scores 4 and 1, with the latter omitting one path required to establish the violation
creation_gate.existing_boundary_insufficient: a fixed read list does not express the consumer predicate, missing observation, result effect scope, dependent-read boundary, or terminal invalidation that govern C147 evidence admission
creation_gate.replaced_predicate: allow evidence only when a nonterminal unobserved review predicate, its missing observation, and a result capable of binding that observation are identified
creation_gate.removed_decision_points: case-specific read-count admission, interface discovery as an evidence reason, confirmation-only rereads, and blanket reopening of already bound review predicates
creation_gate.new_decision_points: joint issuance for requests whose results cannot change each other and one-result-bound exception admission for genuinely unresolved predicates
creation_gate.quality_check: the complete path set used to establish a violation must equal path plus related_paths before a finding becomes terminal
creation_gate.mechanism_check: each additional evidence request is attributable to a permitted preceding result and no evidence is issued after every required review predicate is terminal
creation_gate.stop_condition: do not claim C147 effect transfer, held-out generalization, adoption, release, or runtime projection from artifact creation or C02 development calibration

control_source.transfer: target-specific semantic translation for PR review evidence; not a verbatim copy or an effect claim

fixed: Candidate169 finding admission and identity normalization
review contract and structured output schema
non_goals: fixed fixture command list or fixed read count
case-specific expected answer, path, or oracle hint
fresh held-out effect, generalization, adoption, release, or runtime projection
